items.title: Police Scotland carrying out 'active inquiries' into Andrew and Epstein Balmoral visits
items.summary: The force said it had received information and stressed its inquiries were at "an early stage".

items.title: Bomb squad called and homes evacuated after 'neighbour dispute'
items.summary: Homes have been evacuated while a bomb squad examines "several suspicious items" found by police after a row between neighbours.

items.title: Streeting denies 'kicking can down the road' in defence spending row
items.summary: The government is under pressure to set out a path to greater defence spending, as ministers unveil plans to boost UK firms.

items.title: Bugatti CEO chases down car thief - then offers him lift home
items.summary: The head of the luxury car-maker Bugatti has promised to stop leaving his keys in his own car after his £2m model was stolen from a company site in Zagreb.

items.title: Driver guilty of dragging head teacher to his death
items.summary: Simon Richardson is convicted of murdering head teacher Michael Mullins and will be sentenced on Monday.

items.title: Yorkshire Water boss resigns after company given lowest environmental rating
items.summary: Yorkshire Water has announced its chief executive is stepping down - a day after the company was given the lowest environmental rating by regulators.
